title: How a solar cell makes electricity (15–20 s test)
summary: From a sunlit solar panel, the camera dives into the silicon to see a photon free an electron at the p-n junction, then pulls back to the current lighting a bulb, and loops.

scenes.name: Sunlit solar panel
scenes.sees: A solar panel of dark blue cells in low warm sunlight

caption.title: How a solar cell makes electricity

scenes.name: Photon at the junction
scenes.sees: A photon enters the silicon, frees an electron and a hole, and the junction's field pulls them apart

caption.title: A photon frees an electron
caption.line: The junction's field pushes it out

scenes.camera: continuous dive through the cell surface into the junction, then hold
scenes.illustrative: layers not to scale; charges symbolic

scenes.name: Current lights a bulb
scenes.sees: Pulling back, a wire from the cell carries the current to a glowing bulb

caption.title: Current flows
caption.line: Electrons run through the wire to the bulb

scenes.name: Back to the panel
scenes.sees: The view settles back on the panel
scenes.camera: pull back to the opening pose
